title: Comment "Name" and I'll send you all the prompts 👇 What happens when you ask ChatGPT to find
description: Comment "Name" and I'll send you all the prompts 👇 What happens when you ask ChatGPT to find everyone in the world that has your exact name? I tried this and it literally found 5 random people living 5 completely different versions of my life. Here's how: Prompt 1: Go to ChatGPT, choose Work at the top, and say: "How many people in the world have my exact first and last name, and where do most of them live?" ChatGPT breaks down exactly how rare your name is. Some people find out they're one in a thousand. Others find out they're the only one with their name. Prompt 2: "Now tell me the most interesting people in history who have had my exact name and what they did." You might share your name with a war hero, an inventor, or even a criminal. Here's the coolest part: Prompt 3: "@browser Find the most successful people alive with my exact name and rank everyone who shares it. Tell me exactly where I fall." ChatGPT searches the entire internet and tells you straight up whether you're the number 1 version of your own name or number 4,000, and who you'd have to pass to take the top. #chatgpt #ai #chatgptprompts #chatgptusecase #aitools
